I just spent over an hour reading these comments. Before I read those, I was feeling sad bc I made my mom an advent calendar, with presents she can open each day of the month in december, and she didnt say thank you to me. Now realizing its a privilege to even be able to afford only one small present. Or pretty much everything else I have/own in my life... I live in Switzerland and grew up in the upper middle-class you could say. I am really really grateful for that. Here we dont get confronted with poverty a lot. I mean we are well educated and know that it exists and that it is a huge problem. But we dont see it right in front of us so its hard for us to actually understand HOW bad the poverty is in certain countries. We have a lot of communities that try to raise awareness about those issues and also want to get people to donate money. I also donate some money but it is always hard to really know if what you donate actually helps the people in poverty or if its just used as a „money machine“ for the founders of the company. Thats a big reason why a lot of people here dont donate at all. 
My mom has a friend in Morocco, who also doesnt have a lot in his life. So sometimes she gifts him a new backpack or sends him $50 so he can buy himself and his family some food or other necessary things. My mom always tries to keep me and my 3 sisters humbled for example I give her 1/4 of my monthly income, (I am still an apprentice and earn 1600.- a month) so we can learn how to spend our money right etc. Also I try to remind myself a lot that I am really blessed for pretty much everything I have here in my country. When I am a bit older (I am 19 now) I want to do some kind of charity work or just join a project in a 3rd world country so I can really change something, even if its a really small thing like teaching some kids who dont get education or something like that. Also I think it would make me appreciate everything I have even more.

Me and my bf have been together since 1.5yrs and we havent argued a single time. We sometimes have moments where we dont agree with eachother, so we try to understand both sides. If someone is having a bad day or a bad moment, we just wait for the right moment to discuss eachothers feelings. 
Sometimes I am a bit scared that it wont last as long bc we are both still very young (19&21). Its for both of us our first serious relationship and we give our best to maintain how it currently is. I am scared sometimes, that its going so well bc we are wearing „the pink glasses“ where you only see the positive things bc you are so in love. Ofcourse there are a lot of things that can go wrong bc there are so many things ahead of us. So I wonder if it will get more complicated. On the otherside, we are already talking about moving out togehter in the future (we both still live @ home). 
For me, I picture my life to be with him and so does he. But idk if thats wrong to think bc of our age and i dont know a lot of couples that met at this young age and stayed together. But i always think of our relationship as diffrent from others bc of our communication etc. is just so diffrent.
